comparison.rooms: Two-bedroom, two-bathroom villas with a lounge, kitchen and patio.
comparison.inclusions: Self-catering or selected breakfast packages; confirm restaurant and shuttle arrangements.

title: Tsowa Safari Island
location: Zambezi National Park, upstream of Victoria Falls
summary: A tented island retreat on the Zambezi, reached by arranged road, park and boat transfers.
bestFor: A quieter island safari stay
highlights: Pre-booked transfers including a boat crossing
body: Tsowa Safari Island occupies a river island within Zambezi National Park, upstream of Victoria Falls. Tented accommodation, shaded decks and forest paths make the island itself part of the stay.

Access is by pre-booked transfers, including an open vehicle through the park and a short boat crossing. The lodge offers river and land activities; check the current programme, child policy and river conditions when choosing your dates.

title: Anantara Stanley & Livingstone Victoria Falls Hotel
summary: A boutique hotel in a private game reserve, with suites, reserve experiences and dining at 1871 Restaurant.
bestFor: Hotel comforts in a private reserve
highlights: Selected suites with private heated pools
body: Stanley & Livingstone now operates under the Anantara name. It sits within a private game reserve outside Victoria Falls, pairing a boutique hotel stay with access to reserve experiences.

Accommodation includes interconnecting suites and selected private heated pool suites. Confirm the exact category and whether drives, meals or spa treatments form part of your package. Airport transfers are offered for a fee with advance booking.

title: Mpala Jena
summary: A small riverside safari camp with shaded suites, a river-facing pool and land or water activities.
bestFor: A stay centred on the upper Zambezi
highlights: Game drives, guided walks and boating programmes
body: Mpala Jena sits on the banks of the Zambezi within the national park, upstream of Victoria Falls. Suites, thatched shared areas and a river-facing pool keep the water at the centre of the stay.

The camp lists double or twin suites and two-bedroom family suites. The separate Mpala Jena Private Villas are farther upstream and are a different booking. Published camp packages include meals and guided activities; confirm levies, transfers and any stay-length conditions.

title: The Elephant Camp
summary: Tented suites on a sanctuary ridge, with private plunge pools and views towards Batoka Gorge and the Falls spray.
bestFor: Private suites and a lodge activity programme
highlights: Standard luxury and family suite categories
Sanctuary, gorge and Falls spray outlooks
body: The Elephant Camp sits on a ridge within the Wild Horizons Wildlife Sanctuary. Tented suites have private decks, outdoor showers and plunge pools, with views towards the gorge and distant waterfall spray.

Main Camp and Camp West have different accommodation arrangements, including family suites. Published packages include meals, local drinks and guided outings. Ask for the exact activity list and excluded park charges rather than assuming every nearby experience is included.

highlights: Raised canvas suites with private balconies
body: The Wallow Lodge is set within the Wild Horizons Wildlife Sanctuary along the Masuwe River. Raised tented suites have sitting space, viewing decks and outdoor showers beneath the riverine trees.

The lodge combines a bush setting with organised visits to the Falls and sanctuary activities. Compare the complete package, including meals, drinks, transfers and entry charges, so you can plan outside excursions around the lodge programme.

Breakfast served in the dining boma
body: Bayete Guest Lodge is the founding property of the Bayete Collection. Its rooms are set in tropical gardens around a teardrop-shaped pool, with a dining boma and bar for shared time.

Choices include classic and executive rooms, triples and a two-room family cottage. Published rates include a full English breakfast; lunch and dinner are available on request. Confirm the layout carefully, as the family cottage shares a bathroom and has no living room.

highlights: Dedicated dining room and game-viewing deck
body: Victoria Falls Safari Club is a distinct accommodation option on the Victoria Falls Safari Collection estate. It has its own dining room, viewing deck and pool, with an outlook over the surrounding bush.

Rooms list convertible twin-to-king beds and a minibar with specified local drinks. Check the current guest age policy, meal inclusions and Club benefits directly. Facilities and inclusions differ from the neighbouring Safari Lodge and Safari Suites.

title: Victoria Falls Safari Suites
summary: Multi-bedroom suites with shared living space, suited to families or friends staying together on the safari estate.
bestFor: Family groups wanting separate bedrooms
body: Victoria Falls Safari Suites provide a multi-bedroom option on the Safari Collection estate. Separate sleeping areas, a lounge and study give families or friends more shared space than individual hotel rooms.

Bedrooms have convertible twin-to-king beds, while selected sofa-bed arrangements are intended for children. Breakfast is served at MaKuwa-Kuwa Restaurant. These suites are not advertised as self-catering lodges; choose Lokuthula if a full kitchen is central to your plans.
